description: The local and Master-mirrored user/model inventory Qdrant keeps. Open WebUI remains authoritative; Qdrant is a searchable mirror and the backup source.

point.vector: one zero float; the inventory is filtered/scrollled, not similarity-searched

sources.users: GET /api/v1/users/ with the node service-account token
sources.usage: chat.finished/message events and bridge session model metadata only; never persisted prompt text

rules.single_writer: the inventory agent writes Qdrant; an operator or model never edits a point by hand
rules.event_driven: auth/user/model/chat events update immediately; a full reconciliation runs at startup and every five minutes
rules.durable_outbox: the peer keeps an outbox and retries until the Master acknowledges
rules.no_authority: an inventory point is descriptive; it grants no capability and changes no registry entry
